audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer sets diff to "HARD" while diffRating is 4/10, breakdown.difficulty says "Favoured matchup" and the Emerald+ win rate is 54.64% over 97 games. The banner contradicts every other field on the page.
audit.why: Ornn has no innate sustain, no ranged answer to an 850-range Noxious Blast, and one repeatable charge on a 14s cooldown. Nothing in the kit supports a HARD banner.
audit.corrected: diff should read FAV. Not proposed as an edit because a 4-character enum cannot be changed inside the +/-10% length band — flagged for a manual pass.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appears anywhere in either layer, and dosFull[2].d invites a commit on a "fifteen-second" Volcanic Rupture that is actually 9/8.5/8/7.5/7.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9s at rank 1 and Searing Charge 14s — those two numbers are the whole spacing plan against Ornn, and one of them was stated wrong by 6 seconds.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d: Volcanic Rupture 9s, Searing Charge 14s, Miasma 24s, Petrifying Gaze 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text tells you to "save Petrifying Gaze to stun the elemental's charge". The elemental summoned by Call of the Forge God is not a champion and cannot be stunned. The real interaction — Miasma grounding Searing Charge, and Petrifying Gaze stunning Ornn on the recast that redirects the elemental — is the one that decides the fight.
audit.why: Riot: Petrifying Gaze "stuns any enemies in front of her that are facing her". Ornn recasts R himself to charge into the elemental, and that recast is a champion action you can stun. Searing Charge is a charge that Miasma grounding denies, which is why the wall-slam knockup never lands on a grounded Ornn.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text rewritten to aim R at Ornn on the recast, not at the elemental.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Twin Fangs" appears in content wants.you[0] and full phases[2].why. The ability is Twin Fang, singular.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon names the E "Twin Fang".
audit.corrected: Both instances corrected and the 0.75s recast stated where the name was fixed.

edits.before: Reach your level 2-3 Q-to-E poison chain and chunk an Ornn who can't heal the DoT or run from refunded Twin Fangs
edits.after: Reach your level 2-3 Q-to-E poison chain and chunk an Ornn who can't heal the DoT or outrun a 0.75s Twin Fang

edits.before: Your Q-into-E poison chain comes online — Ornn has no innate sustain and no dash off cooldown, so every refunded Twin Fang on a poisoned target out-trades his Bellows Breath pokes.
edits.after: Your Q-into-E poison chain comes online — Ornn's only repeatable charge is Searing Charge (E) on 14s, so between them a 0.75s Twin Fang on a poisoned target out-trades his Bellows Breath poke.

edits.before: Ornn's comeback is teamfight — his R elemental's double-knockup and Brittle setup. Stay spread and save Petrifying Gaze to stun the elemental's charge before it locks your carries.
edits.after: Ornn's comeback is teamfight — Call of the Forge God's double-knockup and the Brittle it stacks. Stay spread and hold Petrifying Gaze for Ornn himself on the recast that redirects the elemental.

edits.before: Full kit: Q poison into E-spam is real DPS already. Twin Fangs cost almost nothing on poisoned targets.
edits.after: Full kit: Q poison into E-spam is real DPS already. Twin Fang recasts every 0.75s and heals you off the poison.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Pillar + knockup setup — stay off walls and sidestep the line. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: 9s at rank 1 — pillar plus knockup setup, so stay off walls and sidestep the line. Searing Charge is 14s. - Your Miasma is 24s: it grounds his charge. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s: it answers his commit.

edits.before: Ornn burns Volcanic Rupture on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Ornn burns Volcanic Rupture on nothing — take the nine-second invitation.

notes: diff field still reads HARD against a 54.64% favoured lane and a 4/10 diffRating — cannot be fixed inside the length band, needs a manual enum change to FAV. Ornn Searing Charge is treated as a charge that Miasma grounding denies; the kit file does not carry a dash flag on E even though Riot's text reads "Ornn charges", so that specific claim is Medium confidence.
